newsitem.title: USA: Buckeye revises plan, ups proposed payout.
newsitem.headline: Buckeye revises plan, ups proposed payout.

text.p: Buckeye Management Co said on Tuesday it revised its employee stock ownership plan as part of the settlement of a class-action suit.

The revised terms include an increase in the quarterly cash distribution on Buckeye Partners LP units to $0.88 per unit from $0.75, following approval of the restructuring transaction by unitholders, the company said in a news release.
Buckeye Management is the general partner of Buckeye Partners.

Also as part of the settlement, the employee stock program restructuring terms were revised to reduce the maximum value of the transaction based on the number of units to be exchanged with the employee program, and to reduce the amount of incentive compensation payable by the partnership to the general partner at current distribution levels.
Unitholders were to vote on the proposed restructuring at a special meeting scheduled for August 11, the company said.
Buckeye Partners is an independent petroleum pipeline company. Its units closed down 3/8 to 43-3/8 on Tuesday in New York Stock Exchange trading.
